svg.aria-label: How to write ఞ: 8 strokes · 7 pen lifts · 8 movements
svg.title: Writing ఞ
svg.desc: 8 frames; frame N shows movements 1 to N of ఞ (telugu), the movement being added drawn in ink over the finished letter, whose outline is read from _fonts/NotoSansTelugu-Static.ttf. Stroke order after Sathish Shanmugam, Write Telugu Alphabets, consonant ఞ packaged tracing guide res/drawable/dot_stroke_c_2_5_na.png, movements 1–8 (version 2.6) <https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.sathishshanmugam.writetelugualphabets>. Source note on variation: The packaged tracing guide numbers eight separately positioned directional movements across the upper loops, lower body, right bar and upper stem. Telugu letter direction is not uniform across the script, so this is one attested pedagogical order fitted to the bundled Noto Sans Telugu outline.
svg.text: How it is written — 8 strokes · 7 pen lifts · 8 movements
Stroke order after Sathish Shanmugam, Write Telugu Alphabets, consonant ఞ packaged tracing guide res/drawable/dot_stroke_c_2_5_na.png, movements 1–8 (version 2.6)
This order is attested, not standardised; the source records where it varies.
